cause: Local native collinear assertions take a/b/c, not points; tolerance is absolute cross-product area, not perpendicular distance. The first validation failed its field contract before any rendering.
affectedOnly: Eight collinear assertion encodings. No source, authority text, objects, visible labels, endpoints, arrows, topology, waves, display or connects assertions changed.
correction: Replace points triple with a/b/c. Use 0.001 area tolerance for six-decimal rounded intended-collinear endpoints. Incoming source ray is approximate near-straight, not an exact geometric given; 800 canvas-square-unit tolerance over its roughly 265-unit span allows about 3 units of source-read deviation.
